prompt: Create a refined original app logo symbol for 'Vectra Studio', a local aquarium return-pump control application. One centered symbol only, no text or letters. A bold geometric V made from two flowing water ribbons, integrated with a single subtle circular water-current arc, communicating controlled circulation and quiet precision. Distinctive clean flat graphic, crisp edges, generous negative space, compact balanced silhouette readable at 48 pixels. Ocean teal #087E88, bright aqua #39C6CD, deep navy #11363D, simple two-tone shapes. No gradients, shadows, 3D, mockup, border, aquarium illustration, fish, stock water droplet, existing manufacturer branding or watermark. Square canvas with genuinely transparent background, symbol occupies roughly 80 percent of canvas.
refinement_prompt: Refine this Vectra Studio logo, preserving exactly its V-shaped two-ribbon water mark, surrounding broken circular flow arc, teal/aqua/navy palette, size and composition. Clean up ALL ragged pixels and noisy shards along the diagonal split in the right ribbon and near the ribbon edges. Make that diagonal split one perfectly smooth continuous narrow transparent wave of negative space. All contours should be smooth, crisp, flat graphic shapes that read clearly as a small app icon. Keep transparent background. No text, no added elements, no shadows, no mockup.
selection_note: The first generated mark is the selected project logo; icon derivatives are resized copies with transparency retained.
